parts:
Can you resend the plots in something other than .rar format?
Like a gzipped tarball or a zipped directory?

There's nothing fundamentally wrong with the model specification
I can see. There are a couple of challenging pieces of it.

First is the explicit latent overdispersed binomial.

Second is the challenge of identifying parameters in this setup:

parameters {
real<lower=0,upper=10> sigmaalpha;
real<lower=0> delta;
...
}
transformed parameters{
real<lower=0> mualpha;
mualpha <- delta * sigmaalpha;
...
model {
sigmaalpha ~ uniform(0,10);
delta ~ normal(0,1)T[0,];
...
alpha ~ normal(mualpha,sigmaalpha);
...


The only identification comes from the normal(0,1) on delta, which will tend to
drive it as small as possible. Does sigmaalpha hover around the boundary at 10?

You can also make the model more efficient using logit instead
of probit (the link function is computationally simpler). And you
could apply the Matt trick to the hierarchical parameters, which should
also help.

- Bob

The model is the same as I specified before. I was trying to find the problem while keeping the model as it is. But OK, I'll also try the Matt trick and logit instead of probit. 
What I wanted to show you are those chains, which are for parameter Delta.  Why is there such autocorrelation? 

The model:data{ 
  int<lower=0> ns;
  int<lower=0> nb;
  int<lower=0> nn;
  int<lower=0> sb[ns];
  int<lower=0> sn[ns];
}
parameters{
  real<lower=0> delta;
  real<lower=0> deltaprior;
  real<lower=0> mu;
  real<lower=0,upper=10> sigma;
  real<lower=0,upper=10> sigmaalpha;
  vector[ns] alpha;
  vector[ns] phin;

vector<lower=0,upper=1>[ns] thetab;
  vector<lower=0,upper=1>[ns] thetan;
  vector[ns] phib;

  mualpha <- delta*sigmaalpha;
  phib <- phin + alpha;

  for (i in 1:ns){
    thetab[i] <- Phi(phib[i]);
    thetan[i] <- Phi(phin[i]);
  }
}
model{
  # Priors
  delta ~ normal(0,1)T[0,];
  mu ~ normal(0,1)T[0,];
  sigma ~ uniform(0,10);
  sigmaalpha ~ uniform(0,10);

  alpha ~ normal(mualpha,sigmaalpha);
  phin ~ normal(mu,sigma);

  sb ~ binomial(nb,thetab);
  sn ~ binomial(nn,thetan);
